title: Design lock: schema, core, provider seam, doctor
description: Every data shape is a Pydantic model; design rules enforced by autotester doctor

title: Credential boundary (.env -> browser, never a model)
reason: Umesh: credentials must be highly secure so the system and portal-explorer can use the portal in a live visible browser; adversarial checker found and closed 8 leaks over 3 cycles
description: Secrets load from the repo-root .env and are typed into the browser only on an allowed host; prompts, logs, screenshots and artifacts never carry a value

title: Living map + feature ledger (snapshot, MAP, FEATURES, relitigation gate)
reason: Umesh (grill 2026-09-03): the ERP project lost human control because state lived in chat and a hand-maintained map; here everything derivable is generated, every change is a dated row with a reason, and doctor fails on staleness — so a human engineer and Claude read the same small, true picture
description: One derived snapshot injected at session start; a date-wise feature ledger with reasoning; a relitigation gate that asks before a retired feature is rebuilt; every doc self-describes and CLAUDE.md routes

title: Pathlynks onboarded: real login via credential boundary
reason: Umesh provided the counsellor and user dev-environment credentials directly so this gate could clear; first proof the whole credential boundary (T-011+T-010) holds against a real product, not just fixtures
description: projects/pathlynks/project.json declares the dev-environment SecretRefs; scripts/onboard_pathlynks.py logs in as the user role via SecretStore+BrowserSession (never portal-explorer's raw MCP typing, which would have leaked credentials into the session transcript) and writes knowledge.md

title: Grade stage: independent stateless judge, rubric in / Verdict out
reason: Task note: independent stateless grader, rubric in / Verdict out — the plan's core-invariants C7 'the executor never grades itself' made literal; this is the mechanism the north star's bugs-found/false-positive scoring depends on, and it directly implements the eval row 'seeded fake-pass rejected 100%'
description: stages/grade.py::grade judges a RawResult's evidence against a Rubric in a fresh, stateless context — deterministic outcomes (BLOCKED_HITL/ERRORED) never reach the judge, and any unevidenced or self-contradictory judge output is downgraded to INCONCLUSIVE rather than trusted

title: Multi-vendor provider fallback (LangChain)
reason: Umesh, on provider architecture (qa/feedback-inbox.md, 2026-09-03): no single-vendor dependency, wants a LangChain-based fallback chain; this directly unblocked T-050's grading, which was stalled on ANTHROPIC_API_KEY being empty, and everything downstream of T-050 (T-090/T-100/T-110/T-120).
description: LangChainFallbackProvider tries Anthropic -> Gemini -> Ollama -> ChatGPT in order, falling through on any tier failure, so no stage depends on a single vendor's key/uptime.

title: First real Pathlynks run: 3 hand-written login cases (best/worst/edge), headed browser, graded by LangChainFallbackProvider
reason: Task note: 'Proof the loop closes end-to-end on a real product. Zero secret hits in runs/.' — this is the first real, fully-graded proof the whole pipeline (project -> case -> execute -> grade) closes end to end against a real product, not fixtures: 3 headed-browser cases against pathlynks.vidysea.com/signin, each genuinely graded by a real judge (grader_provider=gemini, never mock), verdicts independently confirmed defensible against their own RawResult evidence. Closes AT-033 (F3/F4 were structurally unmet in cycle 1 for lack of a working judge).
description: First end-to-end proof the whole pipeline (project -> case -> execute -> grade) closes against a real product: 3 real headed-browser cases against pathlynks.vidysea.com/signin, each genuinely graded (grader_provider=gemini, never mock) with verdicts independently confirmed defensible against their own RawResult evidence -- BEST landed on /dashboard, WORST/EDGE stayed on sign-in. Closes AT-033.

title: Video ingest: Gemini vision provider + stages/ingest.py video-to-FlowSpec mapping
reason: T-060 note names a further bar this unit does not attempt: >=90% step recall vs a hand-written list on a real demo video. No Pathlynks demo video exists in this repo yet, so that golden-test acceptance is still undeliverable -- closed T-060 on its literal done_check (uv run pytest tests/test_ingest.py -q, exit 0) only; the recall bar is a follow-on task once a real video lands.
description: Watches a demo video via GeminiProvider.see_video and maps the VideoObservation into a fresh FlowSpec (screens/flows/steps), every Step provenance-tracked to the source video's t_start/t_end. Tested end-to-end against MockProvider only (6 tests in tests/test_ingest.py + 4 GeminiProvider tests in tests/test_providers.py, all green).

title: Video ingest: Gemini vision provider + stages/ingest.py video-to-FlowSpec mapping

title: FlowSpec review gate: approve/request-edit + require_reviewed CLI
reason: North star's own text requires a *reviewed* FlowSpec before generating evals; AT-017 (sweep) originally flagged this as a goal-coverage gap with no task carrying the human review gate.
description: Human-in-the-loop review gate for FlowSpec, gating any downstream case-generation on an approved review status.

title: EXPAND stage: FlowSpec -> taxonomy-class Case[] (the differentiator)
description: expand.py turns a reviewed Flow into one Case per applicable CaseClass -- happy path built with zero provider calls from the flow's own steps, input/auth classes detected deterministically from step shape ({{SECRET:KEY}} convention), all 8 universal classes always asked via the model which may decline (empty ExpandedSteps.steps -> no Case). Verified against the goal task's own bar: the login flow fixture produces 14 applicable classes / 14 cases, >=12 and >=1 per class, by construction not coincidence.

title: EXPAND stage: FlowSpec -> taxonomy-class Case[] (the differentiator)
reason: T-070's own goal-task note names this the differentiator: '>=12 cases for the login flow, >=1 per applicable taxonomy class.' Checker independently reverified the login flow fixture has 14 applicable classes and produces 14 cases by construction (not coincidence of queued mock responses), so the bar is genuinely met, not just claimed.
description: Reason correction for F-011: filled in the actual reason (the auto-fill left the placeholder 'update').

title: COVERAGE stage: route diff -> CoverageGap -> VideoRequest
reason: North star's self-extension half: 'when it meets a screen it does not know, it asks the human for a video instead of guessing' — this stage is that mechanism, checker-PASSed on all four contract criteria (V1-V4).
description: diff_coverage(spec, results) finds any observed URL path with no matching FlowSpec Screen.url_pattern, produces one content-addressed CoverageGap per unseen path (deduped across cases in the same run), and request_for()/ProjectStore.add_request queue exactly one idempotent VideoRequest per gap.

title: Bench: north star scorecard (seeded corpus, real AI trial vs human-oracle baseline)
reason: Task note: 'North star made measurable. Scorecard computed by BenchTrial.score, never by hand.' No live human tester was available this session, so the human side is an explicitly labeled oracle baseline, not a fabricated live trial -- same honesty discipline as T-050/T-060/T-110's documented substitutions. Closes the entire P0-P5 goal backlog (20/20).
description: First real, cited proof of the project's own stated north star -- AutoTester detected a real seeded regression (grader_provider=gemini, non-mock) with 0 false positives, scored entirely through BenchTrial.score, compared side-by-side against a documented human-oracle baseline.

title: Docker + live-watch view (noVNC) + user-friendly UI theme
reason: Umesh: 'where can I watch, run it live, run in docker, make the UI user friendly, don't build new functionality.' Checker-PASSed cycle 1: real docker build+run, a real in-container regression-proof run with a visually-confirmed non-blank screenshot proving the browser renders into the container's virtual display, every existing UI route re-verified behaviorally identical under the new theme wrapper.
description: Containerizes the app with a virtual display and a web-embedded noVNC viewer so a headed browser run can be watched from any browser; every existing UI route now renders through a shared CSS layout with nav and colored status badges. No pipeline logic touched.
